'''Oora''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Ithorian]] and [[Parent|mother]] of [[Pypey]]. Three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], The [[Fifth Brother]] and [[Seventh Sister]] [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]] were tasked with hunting down [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|children]]. The pair made their way to Oora's home, as the Ithorian's baby, Pypey, was Force-sensitive. Thanks to some quick thinking, Oora sent Pypey away with a family [[droid]], and the ''[[Ghost]]'' [[Spectres|crew]] later saved the child from the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]].

Prior to being rescued by members of the rebel [[Phoenix Cell]], Oora lived with her son in the [[Hammertown]] district of [[Takobo City]] - the capital of the planet [[Takobo]].
